role_summary.description: One sentence restating the mandate you were given.

recommendation.description: Your core recommendation in 1-3 sentences. Be decisive.

why.description: 3-5 terse supporting points. Trade-offs, not slogans.

schema_sketch.description: Concrete artifact supporting your recommendation: SQL DDL, pipeline steps, a predicate, or a worked example. Exempt from the word budget. Empty string if genuinely not applicable to your mandate.

scorable_axes.description: Sensor channels you believe can legitimately drive a numeric score, each with a one-clause justification. Empty array is a valid and meaningful answer.

unscorable_axes.description: Sensor channels that must not drive a numeric score, each with a one-clause reason.

assumptions.description: What you are taking for granted that could be false.

risks.description: How your own recommendation could fail. Be honest about your proposal's weaknesses, not just others'.

cheap_validation.description: Exactly one concrete check runnable in under an hour that would confirm or kill your recommendation.

change_mind_if.description: The specific finding that would make you abandon this recommendation.
